attribution.localizedCause: The inherited oracle uses tempfile.TemporaryDirectory on /tmp; the raw capture plus parameter materialization exceeded that filesystem quota even though the main filesystem and the objective temporary-disk budget had ample capacity.

decision.rationale: Authorize a separately frozen retry with the same capture and forward sources, a candidate-owned main-filesystem work root, and the canonical under-100GB temporary-disk guard.

hypothesis.rationale: The exporter never materialized the complete fixture and neither open forward executed, so no tensor or branch comparison tested the hypothesis.

retiredDimensions: Do not stage multi-gigabyte production fixtures in unmeasured system tmpfs or classify quota exhaustion as a model result.
transferableLessons: Place large oracle work trees under the candidate result boundary on the main filesystem and measure them with the official scratch guard. Retain exporter receipts: they proved the 659578911-byte captured parameter container exactly matches the Q3 final-container digest.
uncertainties: State export, fixture packaging, both open forwards, tensor identity, and arithmetic-branch identity remain untested.

reasons: The receipt-bound parameter export failed with write payload: Disk quota exceeded on the system tmpfs before fixture completion or either open-forward run.
